Costume: Narita Brian (School Uniform)
...Khh.
Now then, shall we head over to the spectator stands together?

(Listen well, Brian. There is something you need to understand.
Rivals are also born from those you look away from—from the defeated!)

Playing dumb won't do you any good.
After coming all this way, I'm not going to let you back out of that promise.

I will be waiting for you, without fail.
On the grandest stage of all—the GI.
...! That voice—
Huh? I'm talking to you right now...
I think it's that girl.

Become my Trainer.
And take me to the Twinkle Series...!

Don't underestimate it, Brian.
There are those here far above me.
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!)
...Even if I told you, I doubt it'd matter to you.

Ngh...?! What is this cheer?
It's even louder than Big Sis's race earlier...

She said it herself... "I may fall short now, but I will beat you."
That she would rebuild herself and meet you on the exact same stage one day.
TAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH--!!
Damn straight...! ...Tch!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!)
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!

So if I go, you'll promise never to involve yourself with me again?
No, that's not enough. You'll hand over your Trainer badge too!

...On this day, I took Narita Brian and visited Hanshin Racecourse,
where Biwa Hayahide's Make a Debut race was being held.
...Brian. What race are you running next?
...It's about time.

I heard a distinct gulp.
Yet even that sound—

(But you were too strong. Those expectations were always shattered.
That experience... bred a bad habit of writing people off.)

A real duel doesn't end until one of us drops.
I'm still standing... Don't go ending it on your own.

Biwa Hayahide takes the lead! She breaks completely clear!
The lead is two lengths, now three... No, it's a blowout! A dominant victory!!
You better mean what you said this morning.
Brian, who do you think will win this race?

...Whatever. I don't care.
More importantly, right now Big Sis and I—

And now, up next is the Junior Class Make a Debut!
Who will emerge victorious?!

You came, Brian.
...And you as well.

Come, Brian. Rise to this world.
You haven't even reached the starting line yet.

...Haha! I see, I really did underestimate it.
So this is Tracen Academy.

Yes, deafening. After all, what I ran was only a Debut.
It doesn't even compare to the Main Race.

...Brian, this is the Twinkle Series.
A place where everyone struggles to the very end to reach the top.

(You loved running, and loved chasing, more than anyone.
That's why you naturally yearned for someone who could truly compete with you.)
And so, first, she had to win this race.

That's enough. I'll blow past all of them.
Let's go, Trainer...!

You bet your ass it matters, moron. I'm training like hell till that day comes.
Just to crush you into the dirt.

...I want to change the terms from this morning.
You stay a Trainer. But in exchange—

The roar of the Twinkle Series overwrote everything.
With an intensity powerful enough to seize even her heart.
...Oho.
—A few days after that day.

And here we go, today's Main Race!
The pack is tightly bunched up front. Who will burst into the lead?!

...Still, I managed to bring her here.
All that's left is—

Tch... You really are persistent!!
What obligation do I have to follow you around?!

Big Sis! Why did you hide that you could run like that until now?!
Why didn't you ever invite me to race with you?!

...No way. That was the opponent from back then...?
She never had that kind of tenacity before. No, not even that hunger for victory...!

What is that...?! Since when could she run like that...?! 
With the eyes of a predator, locked only onto the goal—

I didn't win at all...! A monster like that...!
I was never good enough to even challenge her...!
(...Are you watching, Brian?)
